title: Meet Gan Coilson for the first time

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Excuse me, are you sentient?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Excuse me, are you sentient?

nodes.speaker: Gan Coilson
nodes.text: No.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But you can understand me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But you can understand me?

nodes.speaker: Gan Coilson
nodes.text: …No

pronounText.TextHeVersion: …No

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I know someone who has had a similar experience.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know someone who has had a similar experience.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I know someone who has had a similar experience.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I know someone who has had a similar experience.

nodes.speaker: Gan Coilson
nodes.text: Tell Ceres to get lost!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tell Ceres to get lost!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ceres? Who is Ceres?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ceres? Who is Ceres?

nodes.speaker: Gan Coilson
nodes.text: Wait. It's not her who sent you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait. It's not her who sent you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Never met her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Never met her.

nodes.speaker: Gan Coilson
nodes.text: Here's some free advice: try to avoid Ceres.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Here's some free advice: try to avoid Ceres.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Will do... if you answer a few questions.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Will do... if you answer a few questions.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Will do... if you answer a few questions.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Will do... if you answer a few questions.

nodes.speaker: Gan Coilson
nodes.text: Shoot.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Shoot.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How did you become a machine?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How did you become a machine?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How did you become a machine?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How did you become a machine?

nodes.speaker: Gan Coilson
nodes.text: It was escape. My body died and my mind found refuge.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It was escape. My body died and my mind found refuge.

nodes.speaker: Gan Coilson
nodes.text: Child's play. I was Chief Technical Officer at LifeCorp.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Child's play. I was Chief Technical Officer at LifeCorp.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you sure that's what happened?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you sure that's what happened?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Are you sure that's what happened?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Are you sure that's what happened?

nodes.speaker: Gan Coilson
nodes.text: I wonder why someone with so little knowledge would second guess me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I wonder why someone with so little knowledge would second guess me.

nodes.speaker: Gan Coilson
nodes.text: It's nearly impossible to manipulate the memory of modern bots. I should know! I built most of them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's nearly impossible to manipulate the memory of modern bots. I should know! I built most of them.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But that memory could also be implanted, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But that memory could also be implanted, right?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: But that memory could also be implanted, right?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: But that memory could also be implanted, right?

nodes.speaker: Gan Coilson
nodes.text: Tittle tattle. Just... Don't tell my wife.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tittle tattle. Just... Don't tell my wife.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Alright.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not Ceres. Someone else.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not Ceres. Someone else.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No. Ava sent me. My Automata.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. Ava sent me. My Automata.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No. Ava sent me. My Automata.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No. Ava sent me. My Automata.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How would someone like you be able to do that? Transfer your mind?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How would someone like you be able to do that? Transfer your mind?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How would someone like you be able to do that? Transfer your mind?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How would someone like you be able to do that? Transfer your mind?

nodes.speaker: Gan Coilson
nodes.text: Best engineer they ever had!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Best engineer they ever had!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How's life as a bot?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How's life as a bot?

nodes.speaker: Gan Coilson
nodes.text: Great!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Great!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Better than being human?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Better than being human?

nodes.speaker: Gan Coilson
nodes.text: Far better! Everything makes sense now. Suck suck, make things clean, make a difference, have a purpose. It's all very logical.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Far better! Everything makes sense now. Suck suck, make things clean, make a difference, have a purpose. It's all very logical.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Was it an accident?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Was it an accident?

nodes.speaker: Gan Coilson
nodes.text: Becoming a machine? No. It was escape. My body died and my mind found refuge.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Becoming a machine? No. It was escape. My body died and my mind found refuge.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How so?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How so?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Someone could have implanted that memory.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Someone could have implanted that memory.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Someone could have implanted that memory.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Someone could have implanted that memory.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nearly impossible?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nearly impossible?
